x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.description: If a Scripted REST API resource has 'requires_snc_internal_role' set to false, then keep it false, otherwise check 'requires_authentication' to determine its value as follows: If a Scripted REST API resource has 'requires_authentication' set to true, then set 'requires_snc_internal' to true. If a Scripted REST API resource has 'requires_authentication' set to false, then set 'requires_snc_internal' to false.
